svg.title: rocketmq-runtime architecture
svg.desc: An application entrypoint such as the broker, the NameServer, the proxy or the controller fills a RuntimeConfig, lets RuntimeOwner::plan validate it and builds a RuntimeOwner, which owns one Tokio runtime, the process resources and the sealed root service context. The state of the root task group moves from Open through Closing and Closed to ShutdownCompleted. The root context derives component contexts. A component context gives library code a task spawner, child components and scheduled task groups, the three blocking lanes, and the process budget. Each component has a task group: its spawn gate admits work only while the group is open, and it registers and tracks what it admits. A task group owns service and worker tasks, operation tasks, a scheduled task group with its driver and runs, child components, critical tasks and ServiceManager loops, and its tasks are polled on the Tokio worker threads. The shared blocking lanes for storage I/O, metadata I/O and CPU work admit closures through the scope of the component, a bounded queue and one global budget, and run them on the Tokio blocking pool. The runtime resources hold the resource-budget tree, which is apart from the task tree: the detected memory limit, the process budget, child budgets that reserve along the chain of their ancestors, and permits and budgeted queues. MetadataIoActor queues metadata snapshots, which are charged to the process budget, writes them through the metadata lane and reports durable generations. ServiceLifecycle serves probes, moves from Starting through Ready and Draining to Stopped, and freezes one shutdown deadline; ShutdownReport holds the evidence of a shutdown; Diagnostics samples the tree. RuntimeContext is a harness for tests and migration that borrows a Tokio runtime. Two rows list the order in which start-up brings the parts up and shutdown takes them down. Where motion is allowed, a looping tour plays seven steps: boot, spawn, schedule, block, budget, persist and shut down.
svg.text: Runtime ownership, tracked tasks, bounded blocking work, budgets and shutdown evidence.
budget tree · apart from the task tree
